summary: M4: first live test showed the idle wake works (~1 s); its bugs are fixed (commit a7a14c9: session-bound identity, mcp-parley MCP key that never overwrites foreign entries, monitor heartbeat, reply hint, manifest warnings). Reinstalled: plugin enabled, doctor can-wake-idle. 162 tests, wb verify passes. Review of the fix round running.
assumptions: M1 (recorded 2026-11-07, fix session): The secret-scan regex thresholds are builder-chosen minimum length heuristics (AWS AKIA +16 chars; ghp_/github_pat_/sk- at 20+ chars; Slack xox*- tokens at 10+ chars; .env SECRET=TOKEN=PASSWORD=API_KEY lines with values of 12+ chars). They may need tightening after real-world false negative/positive feedback; none may ever be relaxed to log the secret value.

M1 (recorded 2026-11-07, fix session): everyone fan-out derives per-recipient idempotency keys as <base key>::<toAgent>; the double-colon separator is a builder choice, and changing it changes which retries dedupe.

M1 (recorded 2026-11-07, fix session): Claim globs (src/core/glob.ts) follow mk-like path-glob semantics without character classes: * matches within one path segment, ** matches across segments (including zero directories for **/), ? matches one non-separator character.

M1 (recorded 2026-11-07, fix session): Retention is keyed on messages.sent_at (PLAN 4.7 'older than 30 days' interpreted relative to send time), agreements.created_at, edits.at, and message-events are deleted with the messages that own them regardless of event time (keeps FKs safe).
M1 (recorded 2026-11-07, fix session): SQLite connections use WAL journal mode and a 5 s busy_timeout by default; concurrent writers wait briefly instead of failing immediately.
M1 (recorded 2026-11-07, fix session): A reply implies read (PLAN 4.3): delivered->replied is allowed and stamps read_at with the replied timestamp; read->replied keeps the earlier read_at.

M1 review round 1 disputed (opencode.json): the default-model change in opencode.json was requested by the user in chat and recorded as human_approved_exceptions in .workbench/tasks/M1/scope.json, but the record was written by an assistant session; the user should confirm the entry (or tell the workbench to forget it) in M2.

M2 (recorded 2026-11-07): MCP server identity defaults to PARLEY_AGENT_ID env, else harness@folder from PARLEY_HARNESS/cwd. Real adapters (M4+) replace this. Tool-definition tokens estimated at chars/4 (project's own cost model) over JSON.stringify of listTools output; budget is 1,500, measured ~518. Agreement recipient is derived as the latest direct message recipient in the thread. Counter-proposal marks the original 'countered' and inserts a new 'offered' row with parent_id. Rules-file text goes out once per inbox session (ctx.rulesTextSent). wait_for_reply_s polls findLatestReplyTo at 25 ms intervals.

M2 (recorded 2026-11-07, fix session): The serve command itself (the `parley-mcp serve` CLI wiring in src/cli) is deferred to M3; M2 only owns src/mcp/server.ts#serve and its stdio database lifecycle. src/cli is forbidden in M2 and was not touched.

M3 (recorded 2026-11-07, kiro): offered_to nullable-vs-required (M2 follow-up 3) resolved by folding `offered_to TEXT NOT NULL` into the initial schema (migration 1) and dropping the separate nullable migration 2, since the build is pre-release and no production hub.db exists. A fresh db gets the NOT NULL column; no backfill is needed. If any pre-M3 hub.db exists on a machine it must be recreated (acceptable: no release yet).

M3 (recorded 2026-11-07, kiro): serve() returns a ServeHandle { isClosed(), close() } so the stdio close path is observable/testable. Its db close handler is registered before server.connect and also on stdin end/close; server.connect() preserves and chains an existing transport.onclose (verified in the SDK's shared/protocol.js), so the SDK's close handling is kept.

M3 (recorded 2026-11-07, kiro): resolveRepoRoot uses `git rev-parse --show-toplevel` with a cwd fallback and never throws (discovery groups by that path). resolveDbPath is ~/.parley-mcp/hub.db with a PARLEY_DB_PATH override.

M3 (recorded 2026-11-07, kiro): M3 ships only a fake adapter (src/adapters/fake). It owns ~/.parley-fake/config.json with a managed `parley` key, pretty-printed with a trailing newline so a rewrite round-trips exactly, which makes the byte-for-byte uninstall check deterministic. Real harness adapters, their config paths/formats and hook payloads are M4+ (or M3b once the work harness is named) and go in docs/harness-notes.md.

M3 (recorded 2026-11-07, kiro): inbox drain/watch mark messages delivered but never read — read needs its own evidence (PLAN 4.3). inbox watch polls every 2 s in the command wiring; the pure runInboxWatchOnce step is what tests drive.
M3 (recorded 2026-11-07, kiro): The CLI bin entry src/cli/bin.ts exists but the package.json `bin` field and the compiled path are deferred to M12, since there is no build pipeline yet.

M3 (recorded 2026-11-07, kiro): `pnpm run format` (prettier --write .) reformats the whole repo including committed M1/M2 files and docs, because earlier milestones did not run prettier. Formatting is NOT part of `pnpm check` (the verify gate is lint + typecheck + test). That repo-wide churn was reverted to keep the M3 diff scoped; a dedicated formatting pass is left to the human's discretion.

M4 (recorded 2026-11-07, kiro): User-level Claude Code MCP registration is written to ~/.claude.json under the top-level `mcpServers` key (verified against the official MCP scope docs + current third-party guides, NOT the ~/.claude/settings.json file). The plugin lives at ~/.claude/plugins/parley with .claude-plugin/plugin.json, hooks/hooks.json, monitors/monitors.json (under experimental.monitors) and scripts/. Formats verified against code.claude.com/docs 2026-11-07 (docs/harness-notes.md M4 section); no `claude` binary was run.

M4 (recorded 2026-11-07, kiro): Hook logic lives in TypeScript (src/cli/commands/hook-events.ts + hook-payloads.ts); the plugin's shell scripts only pipe stdin JSON into `parley-mcp hook <event>`. A payload carrying agent_id or agent_type is treated as a subagent event and ignored by every handler (PLAN section 6). The Parley agent id is derived as `claude@<basename(cwd)>` from the hook payload's cwd; the monitor derives the same id from its own $PWD because it gets no session_id. These id-derivation and the monitor's parent-pid/stdout-notification behaviour are ASSUMED and must be confirmed in the human's live two-session test.

M4 (recorded 2026-11-07, kiro): Read-evidence from UserPromptSubmit marks a message read when the message id appears in the prompt text; a still-`sent` message seen in the prompt is delivered-then-read so the guarded state machine moves it legally. Whether Claude naturally echoes a delivered message id into its next prompt is unverified; the monitor line includes the id so it can. Fallback: an unechoed message stays `delivered` (intended, PLAN 4.3).

M4 (recorded 2026-11-07, kiro): DoctorReport gained an optional `hooksTrusted: boolean | null`; the Claude Code adapter reports `null` (plugins/monitors need no per-hook trust). The Adapter interface's install(env, dryRun)/method(env) signatures widen PLAN section 6's zero-arg sketch for testability (temp HOME); documented in src/adapters/types.ts. src/adapters/claude-code/fixtures/*.json are synthetic (marked _synthetic:true) until the human captures real anonymised payloads.

[autonomous] 2026-11-07: The M4 plugin-loading fix is held until the round-1 reviewer finishes, so the reviewer reads a stable tree; then plugin loading and the review findings go to the builder as one fix.

M4 fix (recorded 2026-11-07, kiro-M4-fix): The Claude Code plugin is installed via a local directory marketplace at ~/.parley-mcp/claude-marketplace/ (.claude-plugin/marketplace.json + plugins/parley/), because a folder under ~/.claude/plugins does NOT load (confirmed in .workbench/tasks/M4/plugin-loading.md). install/uninstall/doctor shell out to `claude plugin validate|marketplace add|install|uninstall|marketplace remove|list --json` through an injectable CommandRunner (src/adapters/claude-code/runner.ts); the real runner spawns `claude` and was NOT run by the build. Tests use a fake runner only. The `claude plugin list --json` output shape is unverified and parsed defensively (name/plugin, enabled/disabled/status, array or {plugins:[]}); if the CLI is unreachable doctor reports cannot-wake-idle rather than a false positive. ASSUMED until the human's live test: that these exact `claude plugin` subcommands/flags match the installed CLI and that `plugin install --scope user` enables the plugin.

M4 fix (recorded 2026-11-07, kiro-M4-fix): The MCP server entry in ~/.claude.json carries env PARLEY_HARNESS=claude so the per-session MCP server resolves claude@<folder> — the same id the hooks/monitor use (src/mcp/identity.ts already honours PARLEY_HARNESS, so no src/mcp change was needed). This replaces the earlier implicit mcp@<folder> identity for Claude sessions.

M4 fix (recorded 2026-11-07, kiro-M4-fix): SessionEnd now requeues only messages whose delivered_session equals the ending session (requeueDeliveredToSession); the older requeueDeliveredForSession(exceptSession) is retained for the PLAN 4.3 'fresh session requeue' path but is not yet wired to a hook. Hook handlers write diagnostics to a stderr `status` channel (CliDeps.status / HookEventDeps.status / HookEditDeps.status) so a Claude Code hook's stdout stays empty except genuine deliveries. The monitor script calls `inbox register` (idempotent) and loops rather than exiting if the agent isn't registered yet.

M4 fix (recorded 2026-11-07, kiro-M4-fix): The Stop hook's use of last_assistant_message as read evidence (flagged by the reviewer as beyond PLAN 4.3) was REMOVED, not kept: read evidence is now only a message id in a UserPromptSubmit prompt, an inbox call, or a reply. The fakeAdapter was removed from the production ADAPTERS list (src/adapters/index.ts) and is imported directly in tests; setup/uninstall/doctor accept an injectable adapters list that defaults to the production list.

[autonomous] 2026-11-07: The M4 round-2 fixes proceed without waiting for the npm-name decision, because the fix (installed commands call this repo's CLI by absolute path, written at setup time) is name-independent. Only the published npm name (M12) stays a blocker for the human.

[autonomous] follow-ons: data dir becomes ~/.mcp-parley, plugin/marketplace names use mcp-parley, the repo folder and GitHub repo stay `parley-mcp` (renaming the GitHub repo is an outward action for the human).

M4 fix2 (recorded 2026-11-07, kiro-M4-fix2): Rename applied. `package.json` name, the CLI program name/help, the data dir (~/.parley-mcp -> ~/.mcp-parley; PARLEY_DB_PATH override kept), the marketplace/launcher names, docs and tests are now mcp-parley. Deliberately NOT renamed: the repo-level rules path `.parley/rules.md` (a PLAN product decision) and the `PARLEY_*` env vars (PARLEY_DB_PATH / PARLEY_HARNESS / PARLEY_AGENT_ID are a stable override contract). The repo folder and GitHub repo stay `parley-mcp`.

M4 fix2 (recorded 2026-11-07, kiro-M4-fix2): No installed config runs `npx`. Setup writes a launcher at ~/.mcp-parley/bin/mcp-parley (src/adapters/cli-path.ts) that runs THIS install's CLI by absolute path, and the MCP entry, every hook script, the monitor and the fake adapter's config use that absolute launcher path. A test asserts no generated file contains `npx`; doctor fails when the MCP entry's command does not equal the launcher path (catches a stale npx entry from an older install). ASSUMED / possible dependency: with no build step yet (M12) the launcher runs `node --import tsx <abs>/src/cli/bin.ts`, which needs `tsx` (NOT in PLAN's dep list) — left for the human to add as a dev dep, or it switches to plain `node` once cliEntryPath() finds a compiled bin.js. Not added silently.

M4 fix2 (recorded 2026-11-07, kiro-M4-fix2): PostToolUse and Stop hooks no longer drain (they only heartbeat; PostToolUse also records edits). `additionalContext` for PostToolUse is documented but not reliably surfaced to the model (public bug report), so a drained-but-unshown message would be a silent loss. The monitor is the single mid-turn delivery path (its printed body wakes the session at a safe point). A test proves a mid-turn message stays `sent` through PostToolUse+Stop and is then surfaced/delivered by `inbox drain`.

M4 fix2 (recorded 2026-11-07, kiro-M4-fix2): The monitor passes --session monitor-$$ (its own PID) to `inbox drain`, so monitor deliveries record delivered_session and the session-scoped requeue acts on them; ASSUMED stable for the monitor process's life. readPluginState now requires explicit enabled evidence (enabled:true / disabled:false / status:'enabled') and matches by id/name/parley@parley — a missing enabled/disabled/status field no longer counts as enabled. The exact `claude plugin list --json` shape is still unverified (assumed: array OR {plugins:[...]}, each {name|id|plugin, enabled|disabled|status}).

M4 fix2 DEVIATION (recorded 2026-11-07, kiro-M4-fix2): PLAN section 6 describes agent registration as a SessionStart concern, but the monitor also self-registers `claude@<basename(pwd)>` in EVERY folder it runs in. Why: it must survive the start-of-session race where the monitor starts before the SessionStart hook has registered the agent (otherwise `inbox drain` would have no agent and the first messages would be lost). It is idempotent and never deletes, so the only effect is that a folder with a running Claude session always has a registered agent even if SessionStart was missed. Accepted as intentional.

[autonomous] 2026-11-07 (Claude): instead of adding tsx (not an allowed dependency), added a `build` script (tsc -p tsconfig.build.json -> dist/). cliEntryPath already prefers dist/cli/bin.js, so a launcher written by setup run from dist/ uses plain node. Running setup from the .ts source still writes a tsx launcher (a known limitation; the live-test steps use the build). Found and fixed while building: src/mcp/server.ts imported SDK subpaths without .js, which works under Vitest but crashes real Node; guarded by test/cli/build-imports.test.ts.

[autonomous] 2026-11-07: Review round 3 passed (7/10) but found monitor deliveries are never requeued (high). Fixing it, and the stale docs, before the human's live test, so the test can cover requeue too; not a new review round, since the verdict was pass.

M4 fix3 (recorded 2026-11-07, kiro-M4-fix3): Monitor-delivery requeue (review round 3 HIGH). A monitor delivers with delivered_session=monitor-<pid>, which a Claude SessionEnd (keyed on the Claude session id) can never match, so the message was never requeued. Two complementary fixes, both exercised through the hook entry points: (a) runHookSessionStart requeues this agent's delivered-but-unread messages when payload.source==='startup' (PLAN 4.3 fresh-session rule) via the existing requeueDeliveredForSession(db, agent, exceptSession=newSessionId) — the fresh session has delivered nothing yet, so every prior delivery (incl. monitor-*) is recovered; (b) runHookSessionEnd additionally calls a new messagesRepo.requeueMonitorDelivered(db, agent) that requeues delivered_session LIKE 'monitor-%', since a monitor process never fires a Claude SessionEnd. The misleading test (called requeueDeliveredToSession('monitor-7') directly) was replaced by two tests driving runHookSessionEnd/runHookSessionStart with realistic Claude session ids. ASSUMED: the monitor's PID-based session id always matches 'monitor-%' (set in the monitor script); confirmed in the human's live test (PROGRESS step 8).

M4 fix3 (recorded 2026-11-07, kiro-M4-fix3): Build smoke test (test/cli/build-smoke.test.ts) compiles with `tsc -p tsconfig.build.json --outDir <tmp>` into a RANDOM subdir under the already-ignored dist/ (so the compiled output resolves commander/the SDK from the project node_modules by walking up — a sibling tmpdir outside the project fails with ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND), runs `node <outDir>/cli/bin.js --help` under plain Node and asserts the usage mentions mcp-parley, then removes the subdir in finally. It skips cleanly (returns) when node_modules/.bin/tsc is absent. Complements the static build-imports regex guard with a real compile+run.

M4 fix3 (recorded 2026-11-07, kiro-M4-fix3): Could not add `dist-smoke-*/` to .gitignore (the file-write tool was blocked for .gitignore this session); sidestepped by building into a subdir of the already-ignored dist/ instead, so no .gitignore change is needed.

[autonomous] 2026-11-07, live-test fix round (Claude): (1) MCP key, plugin and marketplace renamed to mcp-parley; setup never overwrites and uninstall never removes an entry under that key that it did not create (commands ending in /.mcp-parley/bin/mcp-parley are ours). (2) Identity follows the Claude session: hooks look up the agent by session_id (cwd only as fallback) so a session that cd's keeps its agent; the MCP server names itself after the session folder (process.cwd()), not the repo root, records CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID, and reuses the session's agent if SessionStart registered it first. Known limit: two sessions started in the same folder still share one agent (the monitor has no session id). (3) A monitor drain refreshes liveness. (4) Monitor lines carry the message id and say how to reply; talk's description says to answer peer messages. (5) Manifests get description/author; failed claude commands report stdout when stderr is empty.
